# Change-points

## Identify change-points

```{r}
### cpt analysis
ssbcpts <- cpt.mean(data = Herring_full$SSB, method = "BinSeg", Q = 6)
plot(ssbcpts, type = "l", cpt.col = "navyblue", xlab = "Index", pt.widt = 4)
cpts(ssbcpts)
#### Index: 4,    18,   20,   40,   54,   72
#### years: 1950, 1964, 1966, 1986, 2000, 2018

### bcp analysis
bcp.ssb <- bcp(Herring_full$SSB)
plot(bcp.ssb, main = "SSB")
which(bcp.ssb$posterior.prob >= 0.5)
#### Index: 20,   37,   54
#### years: 1966, 1983, 2000

#### Changepoints detected by both methods +-1 year and min. 5 years between points:
#### 1966, 2000
#### Opinion: would include 1986/1983 (looks significant) as only detected by BinSeg
```

## Plot Change-points

```{r}
### Load plotting function from "functions.R"
source("R/functions.R")

### Call function plot_SSB_cpt
plot_SSB_cpt_full <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = Herring_full, 
              changepoints = c(1966, 1986,2000), 
              ribbon_colors = c("steelblue", "orange", "grey", "purple"),
              vline_colors = c("black", "grey", "black"),
              component = "Full Stock", 
              SSB_column = "SSB", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd", 
              show_hlines = TRUE)
plot_SSB_cpt_full
```

### Save plots

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SSB_cpt_full.png"),
       plot = plot_SSB_cpt_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# Hysteresis

## Analysis

```{r}
### Check for time-lags
#SSB_test <- Herring_full[-75,]?
ccf(Herring_full$SSB[-(79:78)], Herring_full$F[-(79:78)], type = "correlation") # 3 years lag

#### Make time-lag object
Herring_full$SSB_lag <- lag(Herring_full$SSB, 3)

### Break-point analysis
bpts <- strucchange::breakpoints(Herring_full$SSB_lag/1000000 ~ Herring_full$F)
plot(bpts)
summary(bpts)

bpts_sum <- summary(bpts)
opt_brks <- opt_bpts(bpts_sum$RSS["BIC",])
opt_brks #### 4
bpts2 <- strucchange:: breakpoints(bpts, breaks = opt_brks)
best_brk <- Herring_full$F[bpts2$breakpoints]
best_brk
####  0.28 1.09 0.28 0.189

par(mfrow = c(1,1))
ci_mod <- confint(bpts, breaks = opt_brks)
plot(Herring_full$SSB_lag/1000000 ~ Herring_full$F, type = "p")
for (i in 1: opt_brks) {
  abline(v = Herring_full$F[ci_mod$confint[i,2]], col = "blue")
  abline(v = Herring_full$F[ci_mod$confint[i,1]], col = "red", lty = 3)
  abline(v = Herring_full$F[ci_mod$confint[i,3]], col = "red", lty = 3)
}
### Get corresponding years:
best_brk_years <- Herring_full$year[bpts2$breakpoints]
best_brk_years
#### 1957, 1968, 1983, 1997
```

## Plotting

```{r}
### Call function plot_hysteresis
plot_hysteresis_full <- plot_hysteresis(Herring_full, best_brk_years, "Full Stock")
plot_hysteresis_full
```

### save plot

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "hysteresis_full.png"),
       plot = plot_hysteresis_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 10,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# SRR Non-Stationary

## Analysis

```{r}
### Plot SBB over R
plot_SRR_full <- ggplot(data = Herring_full, aes(x = SSB/1000000, y = R/1000)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = cut(year, 
                            breaks = c(1950, 1957, 1968, 1983, 1997, 2025),
                            labels = c("1950-1957", "1957-1968", "1968-1983", "1983-1997", "1997-2025"),
                            include.lowest = TRUE))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("steelblue", "darkorange", "purple", "lightgreen", "indianred"),
                     name = "Time Period") +
  labs(x = "SSB in million t", y = "R in billions", title = "SRR Full Stock") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
plot_SRR_full

### Run Modelfiting with run_srr_analysis function
results <- run_srr_analysis(
  Herring_full, ICES_data, 
  lag_recruit_col = "R", lag_SSB_col = "SSB",
  norm_recruit_col = "Recruitment", norm_ssb_col = "SSB")

print(results$comparison)

source("R/model_comp_functions.R")
results_2 <- run_srr_analysis(
    data_for_srr = ICES_data,
   recruit_col = "Recruitment",
   ssb_col = "SSB",
   opt_brks_val = 4 # Example: assuming 1 breakpoint for strucchange
 )

 print(results_2$comparison_table)
 print(results_2$glm_diagnostic_results$overdispersion)
```

## Plotting

```{r}
plot_SRR_models <- ggplot(ICES_data, aes(SSB/1000, Recruitment/1000000)) +
  geom_point()+
  geom_vline(aes(col = "seg. neg bi",xintercept = brpt_haddock_negbi/1000), linetype = 2)+
  geom_line(aes(y = coef_haddock_negbi/1000000, col = "seg. neg bi"))+
  geom_vline(aes(col = "segmented", xintercept = brpt_haddock/1000), linetype = 2)+
  geom_line(aes(y = coef_haddock/1000000, col = "segmented"))+
  geom_vline(aes(col = "segmented log", xintercept = exp(brpt_haddock_log)/1000), linetype = 2)+
  geom_line(aes(y = exp(coef_haddock_log)/1000, col = "segmented log"))+
  geom_line(data = ns_data, aes(ssb/1000,pR_ricker/1000000, col = "Ricker"), show.legend = TRUE)+ #Ricker
  #geom_line(data=ns_data, aes(ssb/1000000,pR_beverton/1000000, col = "Beverton-Holt"), show.legend = TRUE)+ #BH doesn't work because of starting values
  geom_line(data = ns_data, aes(ssb/1000, fitI/1000000, col = "Indipendence"), show.legend = T)+
  geom_line(data = ns_data, aes(ssb/1000, fit_strucc/1000000, col = "strucchange"))+
  labs(col = "Model")

SRR_haddock_models
```
